title: Generative AI Practices, Literacy, and Divides: An Empirical Analysis in the Italian Context

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis and topic modeling of open-ended survey responses where participants reported their experiences with stereotyped AI outputs, such as associating managerial roles with men and caregiver roles with women, as well as linguistic defaults to masculine forms.

Qualitative analysis and topic modeling of open-ended survey responses where participants reported their experiences with stereotyped AI outputs, such as associating images of poverty with people of color and success with white individuals.
Qualitative analysis and topic modeling of open-ended survey responses where participants reported experiences of cultural homogenization and anglocentric responses from the AI.

Qualitative analysis and topic modeling of open-ended survey responses where participants reported the AI's systematic defaulting to masculine forms in Italian, even when gender-neutral source options existed.
